notes.time: a day lesson (training-plan.md §1: every lesson but the night lesson by day)
notes.wind_kt: phase 1 is flown in calm air (inferred: no wind matters on the spot or the taxiways)
notes.start: the base's parking spot for the unit (modern-iaf/data/airbases, airbases.md §5); the altitude: the terrain's ground there (elevation_m without the terrain)
notes.training.time_budget_s: fifteen minutes: the start-up by the card (about 3 min with the INS's 90 s), the shutdown's minute, with time to read the notebook (inferred)
notes.training.end_hold_s: a fail shows its reason 5 s before the debrief: time to see the result
notes.training.checklist: the card items the lesson covers, in the card's order (data/checklists, training.md §12, §16.2)
